segments.text: On the one hand, the state-of-the-art designed machine incarnates all the principles of the dominant International Style, and on the other, a hand-crafted production represents all that the Modern spirit stood against. The robot consists of the perfect act of rupture against historical continuity; it is an invention designed by the sole figure of a pedigreed engineer that embraces innovation and who does not respect boundaries. On the contrary, the factory of the status-quo has nothing to do even with the act of design itself; it is an accumulation of different edifices that count back several generations of engineers with no academic training.
